verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms that Yubico's YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API documentation is live at console.yubico.com/apidocs/, described as the programmatic surface for fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management. That is first-party, but only the page title was verified; nothing documents the depth of the shipping workflow itself. Missing for 10: first-party detail on direct-to-employee shipping (addresses, tracking, international reach), documentation of console-based ordering beyond the console URL, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delivery works end to end.

support.subject: As an IT admin, an enterprise delivery service ships keys directly to distributed employees, driven by an API or console rather than manual logistics

citations.quote: the YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API documentation is live and public at console.yubico.com/apidocs/ (page title verified keylessly) — the documented programmatic surface for fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management.
